description: This file defines an asynchronous function getTenantUsersSummary that retrieves and processes user data from an API endpoint, aggregating user counts by tenant. It imports utility functions for API communication and date filtering, and exports a public function for use elsewhere in the project.

methods.description: Retrieves user data from the API endpoint /api/users with filtering options, processes the data to count users per tenant, and sorts the results by user count in descending order.
